about: Finger-channel mapping table for controllers that report per-finger values through the WebXR Gamepad (buttons[]/axes[]). Matched by inputSource.profiles (first match wins), optionally by gamepad.mapping and minimum button/axis counts. Channel spec: {button: i, field: 'value'|'touched'|'pressed'} or {axis: i}; optional min, max, invert, gamma, touchCurl (curl when only touched). A finger without a channel falls back to the trigger/grip/thumb-touch path. Edit on the headset: debug panel -> Finger mapping (stored in localStorage, overrides this file). See docs/HAND_TRACKING.md.

profiles.verified: emulation only: the IWER test device of tools/emulate_shots.mjs (not a real controller)

NO. Placeholder: no WebXR input profile or gamepad layout for the Steam Frame controllers is published (2026-10). Profile ids here are guesses; channels are left empty on purpose so the generic path and the learn wizard decide. Fill in from the debug panel on real hardware.

partly: the registry profile 'valve-index' exposes only trigger/squeeze/touchpad/thumbstick/a-button (no per-finger axes), so the fallback path is used. Browsers could add extra channels; the debug panel shows them.

fallback.about: xr-standard mapping: button 0 = trigger (index), 1 = squeeze (middle/ring/little), 3.. = thumbstick/face buttons/thumbrest (thumb touch). Touch-only values give a partial curl.
